text:
jake: FYI escalating to CS — AcmeCo trial is blocked during onboarding. SSO redirect loop + provisioning returning 403 for new org creation. Trial ends in 5 days, renewal at risk. Support ticket 98765. @maria can you own? :urgent:

maria: Ack. Can you drop the exact error and the affected user(s)? I'll pull renewal history and prioritize.

jake: Pasting the freshest logs and ticket summary:
```
RequestId: 0x7ab3...
POST /provision/orgs 403
Response: {"error":"provisioning_failed","reason":"client_id mismatch - token invalid"}
SAML: RelayState loop detected for user alice@acmeco.com
Support notes: attempted reissue of SSO cert, still failing.
Ticket: 98765
```

ops_bot: Incident created INC-2026-21876 (priority: high) — added to triage queue.

sara: tagging for enablement coordination — I can run a quick 30m onboarding session + SSO walkthrough. Available today 14:00 or tomorrow 10:00 PT. Which works for the customer? @jake please confirm. :handshake:

ben: provisioning team looking. Quick finding: client_id on the SP metadata doesn't match the one we have on record. Likely config drift after last cert rotation. Quick fix (if they can update SP) is to set `client_id` to `acme-sp-uuid-44` and restart auth proxy: `systemctl restart redwood-auth-proxy`.

maria: Comms plan draft:
- Immediate: Jake to call Alice and set expectation + share workaround (use email SSO fallback if possible).
- 1 hour: Ben to attempt safe config rollback or provide exact SP metadata to customer.
- 4 hours: Enablement session (sara) to validate SSO flow and repro steps.
- 24 hours: Follow-up email with remediation steps + renewal reassessment note to AE.
- Final: Update renewal flag to "at-risk" in Salesforce and loop AE + AM.
Please add any missing items.

jake: Called Alice — she can do tomorrow 10:00 PT. She accepted the temp workaround (email fallback) but wants the onboarding done before trial ends. I pushed ticket 98765 with the workaround steps and added assignee @ben. :phone:

ben: Trying the rollback now in dev mirror. If rollback ok, I'll push config and notifiy with playbook snippet.

maria: Owner: maria (CS lead). Action items assigned: ben (prov fix), sara (enablement session), jake (customer comms). I'll open a mini-impact playbook and mark renewal as "at-risk" — AE @tom to be cc'd on final comms.

sara: Zoom scheduled: https://zoom.us/j/999999999 (tomorrow 10:00 PT). I'll include step-by-step SSO checklist and a short recording for their team.

jake: Added AE Tom and updated ticket 98765 with meeting invite. Customer asked for summary after session.

ben: Push complete — applied client_id fix, restarted auth proxy, validated SAML handshake against test user. Logs show 200 for `POST /provision/orgs`. Asking to validate with Alice.

jake: Confirmed with Alice — provisioning succeeded, onboarding flow continued. She's relieved. We'll still run the enablement session to cover exact config and failover.

maria: Closing escalation from support -> CS. CS actions: run enablement tomorrow, record session, update renewal status post-session. I'll archive playbook and update CRM. Good job team :thumbsup:

sara: I'll capture recording and the short checklist, will drop in this thread once available.

jake: Thanks all — moving ticket to `cs:active` and adding "renewal: follow-up in 48h".

maria: Note for handoff: label `care-path:priority-onboarding` and assign to CS queue. Leaving this thread open until post-session follow-up complete.
